svg.title: One vague whole, five checkable parts, one point
svg.desc: A soft-cornered square block on a base plate divides along dashed seams into five crisp parts: four bars in a pinwheel around a centre cube. The parts still share their edges and fill the same width, held by dashed brackets on the base. Each bar shows a small teal lamp; the centre, the point, stands raised in its slot and glows magenta.
